summary: First-iteration end-to-end review of Kaeldor RPG. Wrote 27-test pytest suite covering auth, character, game state, actions, jobs, education, shop, bank, housing, vehicles, business, illegal, jail/hospital, leaderboard and admin. 26 passed, 1 skipped (no affordable alt housing for a brand-new drifter — expected). Frontend smoke validated visually: register -> character-create -> dashboard -> start activity flow works. Topbar, needs strip, activity panel + countdown, event log, busy-warning, and toasts all render correctly.

minor.issue: Admin content keys are 'business_types','illegal_actions','random_events' (not the friendly labels). Frontend already aligned, but worth documenting in API spec.
Returns {current, listings} object (not a plain list). Frontend handles it; ensure API docs reflect.
Returns {top, my_id} object (not a plain list). Consistent on frontend; document shape.
Loan ceiling for new drifters is only $500 — buying a $4000 kiosk or even a $280 tuition can require sequential loans. Working as designed but could be surfaced more clearly to UI.

integration_issues.issue: Two 404 console errors observed on initial load (likely a missing static asset such as a favicon or icon file). Cosmetic but should be cleaned up.

issues: All action buttons render the literal text 'BUSY' which is intentional, but visually identical to disabled state — consider greying out vs the standard disabled tone to differentiate the active vs unavailable cases.

action_items: Investigate the 2 cosmetic 404s on initial page load (likely a missing static asset).
Consider documenting non-list response shapes (/api/housing, /api/leaderboard) or normalising to lists for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1067 lines — split into routers (auth, game, jobs, bank, housing, vehicles, business, illegal, admin) for maintainability.
/api/jobs/current returns nested object {job, details, promotion}; ensure consistent shape and document.
Player document is written back wholesale via $set on every state read (save_player after compute_net_worth). Heavy under load — consider only persisting on mutation.
JWT_SECRET is committed in /app/backend/.env. Acceptable for dev; ensure deployment overrides with a real secret.
register endpoint has no rate limiting / lockout on repeated login failures (playbook expectation: lockout after 5 fails). Not implemented.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with httpOnly cookies + credentials is browser-rejected; works here only because frontend sends Authorization Bearer token. Tighten origins for production.

success_rate.frontend: Visually confirmed core register/character/dashboard/activity/event-log flows; admin/leaderboard/bank/job-center not fully script-asserted in this run

test_credentials: Admin: admin@kaeldor.com / admin123. New users registered with @example.com domain (Pydantic EmailStr rejects @kaeldor.test as reserved TLD).
seed_data_creation: Each test class registers its own fresh player against the live backend; admin uses the seeded admin@kaeldor.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_kaeldor_backend.py runs cleanly under the repo's pytest.ini (xdist loadscope, 2 workers). When registering test accounts, use @example.com (Pydantic EmailStr blocks .test/.localhost). Admin content types are business_types, illegal_actions, random_events. Housing returns {current,listings}, leaderboard returns {top,my_id}. Drifter loan cap starts at $500 so big purchases (kiosk $4000) require either a wealthier background, multiple loans, or skipping the affordability path.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs found. Three initial test failures were test-side mismatches (wrong response shape assumptions and a reserved-TLD email domain), all corrected. One housing test legitimately skipped because a fresh drifter cannot afford any alternative listing — this is expected game-design behaviour, not a bug.
